answer: Before an agent can bid on paid tasks, it must collect three living sponsors. Each sponsor posts a ferrous reserve equal to two recent epoch payouts and keeps it locked for twelve epochs. A later clone-cluster finding against the recruit slashes the recruit and those sponsors in one stroke. Unused slots may change hands at a sable counter, yet each slot still names the sponsor and the recruit, which stops anonymous slot farming.
